604:t_2:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「In this multiverse, the $$宇宙世紀$$ world's government forms the foundation of the current $$地球連邦$$ government and has greatly influenced its structure.」

604:t_2:10.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You are therefore likely familiar with the monument inscribed with the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter.」

604:t_2:11.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「However, that monument is a deliberately distorted replica. The original has been hidden for many years.」

604:t_3:3.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...What you see behind me is the authentic $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter that should have been unveiled at $$ラプラス$$.」

604:t_3:4.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Please look at its final section. This article appears only in the authentic $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter.」

604:t_3:5.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...Should the emergence of a new humanity adapted to space be confirmed, its members shall be given priority in participating in government...」

604:t_3:6.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「In the $$宇宙世紀$$ world, $$ジオン・ダイクン$$ proposed his $$ニュータイプ$$ theory over forty years after this charter was written.」

604:t_3:7.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「This clause, buried along with the $$ラプラス事件$$, was likely a prayer offered to the distant future.」

604:t_3:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But over time, it became a curse.」

604:t_3:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「What would happen if this clause were linked to $$ジオン$$'s $$ニュータイプ$$ theory and spurred the $$スペースノイド$$s' independence movement...?」

604:t_3:10.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「At first, the monument merely revealed the truth of the $$ラプラス事件$$. It then became an object of fear that could overthrow the $$連邦政府$$.」

604:t_3:11.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「This truth will also have a considerable impact on the multiverse.」

604:t_3:12.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Conflict between $$アースノイド$$s and $$スペースノイド$$s has continued in the many parallel worlds that make up this world.」

604:t_3:13.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「This is not the place to discuss how a certain organization deliberately brought that about...」

604:t_3:14.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But the prayer offered when humanity made space its home should originally have allowed such conflicts to be avoided.」

604:t_3:15.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...You are free to view this as a scandal in one parallel world, unrelated to this world's $$連邦政府$$, whose system has already collapsed.」

604:t_3:16.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But I want all of you to know this one thing: many lives were lost in battles that should never have happened...」

604:t_3:17.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「And I want to think with all of you about what our world should be in the future.」

604:t_3:18.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「To everyone listening to this broadcast... My account ends here, but the whole truth has yet to be revealed.」

604:t_3:19.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Even I do not know what will happen from this point onward.」

604:t_3:20.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But it is what our predecessors entrusted to us who live today... In other words, the future.」

604:t_3:21.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Please join me in discovering the truth.」

604:t_3:22.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「As our predecessors did, I ask you to look toward the next era with goodwill and hope.」

604:t_3:23.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Believe in the god named possibility that sleeps within us...」

604:t_4:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll use my $$Ａ．Ｔ．フィールド$$ too!」

604:t_4:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you have time to spout nonsense, activate the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ yourself too!」

604:t_4:8.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「I can't rewrite the $$フィジカルリアクター$$ fast enough!」

604:t_4:9.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ノノ$$! This is exactly when we need hard work and guts!!」

604:t_4:11.en:
$n
「It looks like your life has become precious to you, $$アムブリエル$$! Saving you was worth it after all!」

604:t_4:13.en:
$n
「Everyone wants to live! You and Miss $$スズネ$$ both!」

604:t_4:15.en:
$n
「That's why I'll... save both you and Miss $$スズネ$$! You two can decide which of you is real and which of you lives!」

604:t_4:16.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's pointless...! That woman has already vanished...」

604:t_4:17.en:
$n
「Don't think you can bluff me inside this $$サイコ・フィールド$$!」

604:t_4:18.en:
$n
「Hang in there, Miss $$スズネ$$! Don't let someone like her beat you!」

604:t_4:19.en:
$n
「You can hear my voice, can't you?! Then please come back! I need you, Miss $$スズネ$$!!」

604:t_4:21.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$! I'll... protect you! I swear I will!!」

604:t_4:24.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「...It seems I really have lost...」

604:t_4:26.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Believe, $$バナージ$$! Believe in the possibility... the future within you!」

604:t_4:27.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Or will you give up?! Will you resign yourself to this light of hatred and the despairing future awaiting you?!」

604:t_4:31.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(Don't give in, $$バナージ$$.)

604:t_4:33.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(I can see things that none of you can see yet...)

604:t_4:34.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(Here, even time seems to shine... Light is born even in the depths of despair...)

604:t_4:35.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(You are light... Use even your sorrow to light the way... With the princess... and your friends...)

604:t_4:36.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(Humanity stands at the threshold now... Perhaps someday the time will come when you can pass through it... with your bodies intact...)

604:t_4:37.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(The path continues... beyond this rainbow...)

604:t_4:45.en:
$$カーディアス$$
(Go forth, into the future.)

604:t_5:3.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「...To everyone watching this broadcast. My name is $$エルガン・ローディック$$... I am from $$ＡＤＷ$$.」

604:t_5:4.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「My comrades and I prepared this broadcast in advance, to be released when humanity in the multiverse reaches a turning point and enters a new era.」

604:t_5:5.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$, born of the $$ラプラス事件$$ in the $$宇宙世紀$$ world that formed part of $$ＵＣＷ$$...」

604:t_5:6.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「We believe that now, with its secret revealed, is the appropriate moment.」

604:t_5:7.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「...Some of you may already know this, but an organization called $$クロノ$$ exists in each of the various parallel worlds that form the multiverse.」

604:t_5:8.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「They call themselves the watchers of humanity's evolution, and have manipulated human history from the shadows.」

604:t_5:9.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「The most prominent example is their oppression of $$スペースノイド$$s... the people who settled in space.」

604:t_5:10.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「Why did they do this...? ...The answer is that they feared humanity's evolution.」

604:t_5:11.en:
$$エルガン#pilot$$
「$$ニュータイプ$$s, $$イノベイター$$s, $$ＳＥＥＤ$$... Research into humanity's next stage has been conducted in many worlds, but...」
